files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed

- **A multi-signer request no longer shows as signed when only the first person
  has signed.** On a tenant subscribed to `TRANSACTION.COMPLETED`, one signer's
  completion marked the whole envelope completed, badged the file "Assinado" and
  stopped checking its status. Only `ENVELOPE.*` events now change an envelope.
- **Requests already marked this way are corrected on upgrade.** Envelopes shown
  as completed with no signed document saved go back to "Pendente" and are
  re-read from SignDocs on the next status check, which restores the real status.
  Genuinely finished ones return to "Assinado" and their document is saved.
- **A late `TRANSACTION.CREATED` can no longer reopen a finished request.** The
  event was applied rather than ignored, which became reachable once SignDocs
  began redelivering failed webhooks.
